name: Wuhan DR Laser Technology Corp.,Ltd
summary: Wuhan DR Laser Technology Corp.,Ltd provides precision laser processing equipment in China. The company offers laser micro-etching equipment; component laser welding equipment and line of products; laser-induced sintering equipment; TOPCon SE laser doping equipment; and laser transfer equipment and production line. It also provides Perovskite laser etching equipment; LIA laser repair equipment; laser ablation equipment; laser drilling equipment; and laser scribing equipment. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Wuhan, China.
